title: Kagamine Rin — All To See You Smile〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, how many times have you asked that already...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But I've really been looking forward to it!
I can't wait to start already.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't worry. Isn't it almost time too?
See, here she comes...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And Haruka, Minori and Shizuku too...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're always welcome!
But what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When I told everyone we were going to sing together, they said that they'd come as a cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I've been wanting to try it out for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We rarely ever get to see the stage as audience members, and I thought that might be nice for change.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. And I prepared a few things so that we can cheer you and Airi on!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Glowsticks, fans and of course...!
Ta-da! A Happi Coat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have a full set for Haruka and Shizuku too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For us too? Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That sounds fun!
Mind if I join your cheer squad too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, also! I memorized all the right places to clap to the song!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll be cheering our hearts out, so you two can just go ahead and enjoy performing on stage together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, you're on different level today, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. Like a true cheer leader♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright then...
Rin, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! We can't disappoint everyone cheering us on, so let's have as much fun as we can, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But we're not done yet!
Our next song is...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Nothing beats being an idol!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? Airi...
Do you hear that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we can't call ourselves idols if we ignore such a passionate request!
